description: List bounded SEPA KiWIS time series for a station_id (station number), including series IDs and reported units (OGL). Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; bounded by this tool's schema.

station_id.description: SEPA station_no returned by sepa_stations (not the internal station_id).

name: sepa_series
